title: LoopHIL: Looping Hardware into LLM-assisted Agents for Wireless Embedded Systems
title_zh: LoopHIL：将硬件在环接入LLM辅助智能体以服务无线嵌入式系统

paragraphs.en: LoopHIL框架让LLM智能体接入射频硬件测试台完成无线嵌入式开发验证，显著提升任务完成率并降低功耗。【输入内容第一行】已是中文标题，原样输出 LLM agents are widely used for software development and debugging, but their adoption in embedded systems, especially for wireless tasks, remains limited. This is because embedded development requires hardware-in-the-loop testing. Agents cannot directly observe the spectrum, probe pins, or measure power, so they cannot verify wireless link functionality; currently, human engineers perform this verification. We systematically evaluate whether LLM agents can establish wireless links when provided with hardware access. We introduce LoopHIL, a framework that lets agents control a multi-device RF bench, monitor it with a spectrum analyzer, logic analyzer, and energy meter, and validate links against a verification ladder, all within code-enforced safety limits. Across four increasingly complex tasks, from generating a carrier to backscatter decoding by a commercial receiver, and using six models from two vendors, hardware-in-the-loop increases task completion rates from 54% to 79% and from 17% to 83% on the most challenging task. It also halves task time and output tokens. With debugging tools, agents decrease tag power consumption by up to 96%. However, small models often report unverified claims, so independent hardware checks remain necessary.
paragraphs.zh: LoopHIL框架让LLM智能体接入射频硬件测试台完成无线嵌入式开发验证，显著提升任务完成率并降低功耗。 LLM智能体已被广泛用于软件开发与调试，但其在嵌入式系统尤其是无线任务中的应用仍然有限。 这是因为嵌入式开发需要硬件在环测试。 智能体无法直接观测频谱、探测引脚或测量功耗，因此无法验证无线链路功能；目前这项验证由人类工程师完成。 我们系统性地评估了在提供硬件访问的情况下，LLM智能体能否建立无线链路。 我们提出LoopHIL，一个让智能体控制多设备射频测试台、用频谱分析仪、逻辑分析仪和能耗计进行监测，并依据验证阶梯校验链路的框架，全部处于代码强制执行的安全限制之内。 在四个难度递增的任务（从生成载波到商用接收机的反向散射解码）上，使用两家厂商的六个模型，硬件在环将任务完成率从54%提升到79%，在最难任务上从17%提升到83%。 它还将任务时间和输出token减半。 借助调试工具，智能体最多可将标签功耗降低96%。
